newsitem.title: USA: AMERICAN FOOTBALL-IOWA BLANKS TEXAS TECH IN ALAMO BOWL.
newsitem.headline: AMERICAN FOOTBALL-IOWA BLANKS TEXAS TECH IN ALAMO BOWL.

text.p: Sedric Shaw ran for 113 yards and a touchdown and upstaged Byron Hanspard as Iowa blanked Texas Tech 27-0 in the Alamo Bowl Sunday.
Iowa (9-3) won its second straight bowl game and finished with three straight wins, completing its best season since going 10-1-1 in 1991.

Hanspard, the Doak Walker Award winner, came in averaging 189.45 yards per game, but was kept in check by a Hawkeye defence that shut out two of its last three opponents. He got 64 yards on 18 carries. Hanspard, a junior, is expected to announce Monday whether he will make himself eligible for the NFL draft.
Texas Tech (7-5) was shut out for the first time since losing to Arkansas 31-0 in 1987. The Red Raiders have lost three of their last four bowl games and were meeting Iowa for the first time.
